page_title: SubList: Subscription Tracker App - App Store

sources.entry: SubList - Track subscriptions, renewals, and spending in one place with reminders, analytics, and iCloud sync.

summary.name: SubList
summary.one_liner: SubList is an Apple-platform app for tracking subscriptions, renewal dates, and recurring spending, with reminders and iCloud sync.
use_cases: track streaming, app, and cloud storage subscriptions
get reminders before subscription payments are due
see monthly and yearly recurring spending
plan upcoming renewals in a calendar
sync subscription data across Apple devices
summary.what_it_does: SubList records subscription prices, currencies, billing cycles, renewal dates, categories, notes, and website links. Subscriptions can be added manually or imported from screenshots and the App Store, with details checked before saving. Users can choose reminder timing and view upcoming payments in a calendar or a list sorted by due date. It shows monthly and yearly totals, spending trends, and breakdowns by category and payment method. Data syncs through iCloud, payment dates can be added to Apple Calendar and Reminders, and CSV exports or shareable spending reports are available.
notable: Imports subscriptions from screenshots and the App Store
Syncs across Apple devices via iCloud with no account signup
Cloud reminders for renewals when local reminder capacity is full (Pro)
Supports 27 languages and Apple accessibility features
caveats: Free plan limited to 3 active subscriptions; unlimited requires Pro
Cloud reminders require notification permission and internet access, and reminder titles and messages are uploaded
In-app purchases: Lifetime Unlock $12.99, Monthly $0.99, Annual $7.99
